newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: INSIGHT -NZ dollar trades sharply lower after CPI.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -NZ dollar trades sharply lower after CPI.

text.p: *DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
* Low CPI, Australian dollar fall, drag NZ dollar sharply down
* Kiwi loses 20 basis points after CPI
"It looks like some exporters have been trying to pick some Kiwi but the offshore guys are trying to sell now," said one dealer.
"Obviously monetary conditions are far too tight in this country. That is what everyone is saying," he said.
"People are saying that there is going to have to be, not a significant easing, but quite a large easing," he said.
